practices.normalizedSummary: Policy evaluation should return a decision and explanation while enforcement remains in the calling boundary that owns the side effect.
practices.evidenceRequirement: existing authorization, planning and transaction boundaries remain separate
practices.rationale: SEC already separates policy, authorization, planning and mutation execution.

practices.normalizedSummary: Design proposals should be reviewed and accepted independently from implementation, stabilization and support promotion.
practices.evidenceRequirement: Issue, Work Package, PR, Evidence and support maturity remain distinct
practices.rationale: SEC already separates proposals, implementation candidates, physical verification and support.

practices.normalizedSummary: Provenance should distinguish things, transformations and responsible actors instead of flattening all lineage into one relationship.
practices.evidenceRequirement: Fact, Assertion, Evidence, execution and actor identities remain distinct
practices.rationale: SEC already maintains separate semantic and Evidence identity domains.

practices.normalizedSummary: Incremental computation should use pure queries, explicit dependencies and fingerprints so unchanged outputs do not invalidate downstream work.
practices.evidenceRequirement: clean and incremental results remain equivalent and cache keys bind full revisions
practices.rationale: SEC already specifies deterministic incremental graphs and conservative invalidation.

practices.normalizedSummary: Two builds with the same declared source and environment closure should produce byte-identical artifacts or an explicit unsupported result.
practices.evidenceRequirement: cross-host clean package rebuild compares canonical bytes and explains allowed nondeterminism
practices.activationTrigger: the public package surface and release builder are stable
practices.reversalCondition: scope the claim to a narrower platform/profile when upstream tools cannot provide deterministic bytes
practices.rationale: SEC requires deterministic lowering, but packaged cross-host reproducibility remains future physical work.

practices.normalizedSummary: Security and reliability fixes should remove the shared root cause and add recurrence barriers instead of repeatedly patching instances.
practices.evidenceRequirement: proof reset, shared abstraction review and permanent regressions remain required for repeated defect classes
practices.rationale: SEC already requires root cause, owner, invariant and permanent regression analysis.

practices.normalizedSummary: Overlapping repository policies should compose predictably, with the effective result never weaker than any applicable mandatory rule.
practices.evidenceRequirement: fork-safe ruleset inventory and effective-policy readback
practices.reversalCondition: replace hosted rule composition with an internal merge gate if platform semantics are insufficient
practices.rationale: SEC merge authority should verify hosted rules rather than assume their configuration.

practices.normalizedSummary: Shared semantic names require a registry, maturity state, compatibility rule and explicit retirement path.
practices.evidenceRequirement: active/reserved/deprecated predicate lifecycle with producer and consumer census
practices.activationTrigger: the first cross-domain predicate set is stable enough to publish as a registry
practices.reversalCondition: retire registry states that duplicate TypeScript discriminated unions without multi-consumer value
practices.rationale: SEC already specifies active/reserved predicates but lacks a complete lifecycle implementation.

practices.normalizedSummary: Changes should be the smallest coherent unit that can be understood, tested, reviewed and reverted independently.
practices.evidenceRequirement: focused Work Package and one decision family per candidate remain enforced
practices.rationale: SEC already uses focused formal candidates and rejects mechanical branch aggregation.

practices.normalizedSummary: Stateful APIs should be tested with generated producer-consumer sequences rather than only isolated requests.
practices.evidenceRequirement: bounded model, dependency inference validation, deterministic replay and minimized failing sequence
practices.activationTrigger: a stable SEC product API exposes meaningful stateful sequences
practices.reversalCondition: remove the harness if it cannot distinguish product defects from invalid generated sequences
practices.rationale: This is valuable after a stable Workbench or service API exists, not before.

practices.normalizedSummary: Build provenance maturity, source integrity and dependency tracks should be measured separately from product compatibility and support.
practices.evidenceRequirement: Support Claim transitions continue to require predecessor-complete evidence rather than one security badge
practices.rationale: SEC already separates Verification, packaging, compatibility and product support.

practices.normalizedSummary: Software update authority should separate roles, support threshold approval and expire stale metadata instead of trusting one long-lived signer.
practices.evidenceRequirement: release metadata roles, threshold verification, expiry and rollback/freeze attack tests
practices.activationTrigger: SEC distributes signed update metadata to external users
practices.reversalCondition: return to manual release verification if operational key separation cannot be maintained safely
practices.rationale: This is unnecessary before SEC has an update channel.
